title.en: An Image from a Brightness Table

blurb.en: Light single LEDs with set_pixel, then turn a 5 x 5 table of brightness numbers into the text an Image is built from.
blurb.zh: 先用 set_pixel 点亮单个 LED，再把一张 5 × 5 的亮度表变成构造 Image 用的那串文字。

en: What the board shows: the display clears, then a diagonal line lights up from the top-left LED to the bottom-right one at full brightness. A second later a heart replaces it, and a second after that the heart gives way to a picture that fades from dark on the left to bright on the right, the same on all five rows. The program then ends and the last picture stays lit.

The display is 5 columns by 5 rows. display.set_pixel(x, y, b) takes the column x first, then the row y, both counted from 0 at the top-left corner, and a brightness b from 0 (off) to 9 (brightest) - so giving the same number for the column and the row lights a cell on the diagonal.

Image can also be built from text: five groups of five digits, one group per row from top to bottom, with a colon ending each row. The heart in HEART reads 09090:99999:99999:09990:00900. Each digit is the brightness of one LED, from the left.

image_string builds that text from a list of five rows. For each row it adds the digits one at a time to line, keeps the finished lines in a list, and joins them with colons. The fading picture comes from fade_rows, whose every row is 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, so the text is 02468 five times over, colon-separated.

sleep(1000) waits 1000 milliseconds - one second. On the micro:bit sleep counts in milliseconds; in ordinary Python, time.sleep counts in seconds. The Scroll, Show and Sleep program says more about that.

The page's checker compares image_string with a version that looks each brightness up in the string "0123456789" and adds the colons by hand on a few hundred made-up inputs. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why image_string must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子上看到的：点阵先清空，然后从左上角到右下角亮起一条最亮的斜线。一秒后换成一颗心；再过一秒，心换成一幅从左暗到右亮的渐变图，五行都一样。之后程序结束，最后那幅图一直亮着。
点阵是 5 列 × 5 行。display.set_pixel(x, y, b) 先给列 x、再给行 y，两者都从左上角的 0 数起，最后是亮度 b，0（灭）到 9（最亮）——所以列和行给同一个数，点亮的就是斜线上的格子。
Image 也可以用文字构造：五组、每组五个数字，一组一行、从上往下，每行末尾用冒号隔开。HEART 里的心写出来是 09090:99999:99999:09990:00900。每个数字是一个 LED 的亮度，从左往右。
image_string 从五行组成的列表拼出这串文字：每一行把数字一个个接到 line 上，拼好的行存进一个列表，最后用冒号接起来。渐变图来自 fade_rows，它的每一行都是 0、2、4、6、8，所以文字是五个 02468，用冒号隔开。
sleep(1000) 等 1000 毫秒，也就是一秒。micro:bit 上的 sleep 按毫秒计；普通 Python 的 time.sleep 按秒计。这一点在「滚动、显示与等待」里细说。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 image_string 与一个在字符串 "0123456789" 里查每个亮度、自己补冒号的版本逐一核对。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 image_string 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: Image(...) turns the text into a picture, and display.show puts it on the LEDs. It stays lit until something else is shown.
lineNotes.zh: Image(...) 把文字变成一幅图，display.show 把它放上点阵；在换别的东西之前它一直亮着。

lineNotes.at: return [[2 * x for x in range(5)] for y in range(5)]
lineNotes.en: The inner list is one row, 0 2 4 6 8; the outer comprehension makes five copies of it, one per row.
lineNotes.zh: 里层列表是一行：0 2 4 6 8；外层推导式把它做五份，一行一份。

blurb.en: Slide text across the display, flash characters one at a time, show built-in pictures, and pause with sleep - which on the micro:bit counts in milliseconds.
blurb.zh: 让文字滑过点阵、逐个字符闪现、显示内置图片，再用 sleep 停顿——micro:bit 上的 sleep 按毫秒计。

en: What the board shows: HELLO slides across the display from right to left, then slides across again noticeably faster. Next the letters A, B and C appear one after another, a heart stays for a second, and a countdown shows 3, 2 and 1, one second each. After the display clears, a heart, a happy face and a sad face take turns for half a second each, with a blank half second after the three - over and over until the power is switched off.

display.scroll moves the whole text across and only returns when it has gone by. Its delay is how many milliseconds each step waits (150 by default, according to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation), so a smaller delay scrolls faster. display.show with a string puts up one character at a time instead; with an Image it simply shows the picture and returns at once.
Image.HEART, Image.HAPPY and Image.SAD are three of the pictures built into the micro:bit. The list PICTURES only names them; nothing is drawn until display.show is called inside main.

sleep(ms) waits for that many milliseconds: sleep(1000) is one second, sleep(500) half a second. In ordinary Python on a computer, time.sleep(s) takes seconds instead - time.sleep(0.5) is half a second. Copying a time.sleep(1) habit onto the micro:bit as sleep(1) waits only a thousandth of a second.

The countdown's range has three arguments: it starts at 3, its negative step counts downwards, and its stop value is never reached - so the stop has to be one below the last number wanted. str(n) turns the number into text, because display.show of a string shows its characters.

The while True loop never finishes. On a computer that would be a bug; on the micro:bit it is normal, because the board has nothing else to do - main.py runs until the power goes or the reset button is pressed. This program has no logic function to check, so the page only makes sure it is valid Python laid out with main() and a single main guard.
zh: 板子上看到的：HELLO 从右往左滑过点阵，接着再滑一次，明显快一些。然后 A、B、C 逐个出现，一颗心停一秒，再倒数 3、2、1，每个一秒。点阵清空后，心、笑脸、哭脸轮流各亮半秒，三个之后空半秒——一直循环，直到断电。
display.scroll 让整串文字滑过去，滑完才返回。它的 delay 是每挪一步等多少毫秒（据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，缺省 150），所以 delay 越小滚得越快。display.show 给字符串时是一次显示一个字符；给 Image 时就把图放上去、立刻返回。
Image.HEART、Image.HAPPY、Image.SAD 是 micro:bit 内置的三幅图。列表 PICTURES 只是点了它们的名，要等 main 里调用 display.show 才真的画出来。
sleep(ms) 等这么多毫秒：sleep(1000) 是一秒，sleep(500) 是半秒。电脑上普通 Python 的 time.sleep(s) 收的是秒——time.sleep(0.5) 才是半秒。把 time.sleep(1) 的习惯照搬成 micro:bit 上的 sleep(1)，只等千分之一秒。
倒数用的 range 有三个实参：从 3 开始，步长是负数所以往下数，终点取不到——所以终点要比最后想要的那个数再小 1。str(n) 把数字变成文字，因为 display.show 收字符串时显示的是它的字符。
while True 循环永远不结束。在电脑上那是 bug；在 micro:bit 上是常态：板子没有别的事可做，main.py 一直跑到断电或按下复位键。这个程序没有可检查的逻辑函数，页面只确认它是合法的 Python，并且按 main() 加一个 main 守卫的结构写。

lineNotes.en: Naming built-in images at the top is allowed: nothing is drawn yet, it is just a list of three pictures.
lineNotes.zh: 在顶层点名内置图片没问题：还什么都没画，只是一个装着三幅图的列表。

lineNotes.en: show with a one-character string puts up that single digit.
lineNotes.zh: show 收到只有一个字符的字符串，就显示那一个数字。

blurb.en: A press is the moment the button goes from up to down. Count those moments in a list of samples, and meet is_pressed, was_pressed and get_presses.
blurb.zh: 按一次，是按钮从「没按」变成「按下」的那一刻。在一串采样里数这样的时刻，顺便认识 is_pressed、was_pressed 与 get_presses。

en: What the board shows: the letter B. Press button B and a target appears: for the next three seconds, press button A as many times as you like. Then two numbers scroll past - first the presses this program counted from its samples, then the board's own count of presses of A in the same three seconds. Normally the two agree. Then B appears again, ready for another round.

The three button methods, as the micro:bit MicroPython documentation describes them: is_pressed() says whether the button is held down right now; was_pressed() says whether it went from up to down since the last time you asked (and asking clears it); get_presses() gives the running total of presses and resets that total to zero. That is why main calls button_a.get_presses() once before sampling - the answer is thrown away, only the reset matters.

Sampling means asking is_pressed every 20 milliseconds and writing the answers down: 150 samples cover three seconds. One press held for a while shows up as a run of True values, so counting the True values would count one press many times. A press is the edge where a False is followed by a True.

count_presses finds those edges by pairing each sample with the one before it: zip walks two lists side by side - samples with one extra False put in front, and samples itself - so each pair is (sample before, this sample). The extra False in front means a button already held when sampling starts counts as one press. For False, True, True, False, True the pairs give two edges - two presses.

The two counts can differ: a press shorter than one sampling gap can fall between two samples and be missed, while the board's own count sees every press. Real buttons also bounce - a single press can flicker between up and down for a few milliseconds - and this program assumes the samples are already clean. Dealing with bounce is on the Embedded Patterns page.

The page's checker compares count_presses with a version that walks the samples once and remembers the previous state in a variable on a few hundred made-up inputs, including lists that are all True and all False. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why count_presses must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子上看到的：字母 B。按一下 B 键，出现一个靶心：接下来三秒里，你想按几次 A 键就按几次。然后滚过两个数——先是这个程序从采样里数出的次数，再是板子自己记的、同样三秒里 A 被按的次数。一般两者相同。之后又显示 B，等下一轮。
按钮的三个方法，照 micro:bit MicroPython 文档的说法：is_pressed() 说此刻按着没有；was_pressed() 说自上次问过以来有没有从没按变成按下（问一次就清掉）；get_presses() 交回累计按了几次，并把累计清零。所以 main 在采样前先调一次 button_a.get_presses()——交回的数丢掉不用，要的只是清零。
采样就是每 20 毫秒问一次 is_pressed、把答案记下来：150 个样本正好三秒。按住不放的一次会记成一串 True，所以数 True 的个数会把一次算成很多次。按一次，是 False 后面紧跟 True 的那个「沿」。
count_presses 把每个样本和它前一个配成一对来找这些沿：zip 把两份列表并排走——前面多放一个 False 的 samples，和 samples 本身——每一对就是（前一个样本，这一个样本）。前面多放的那个 False 意味着采样一开始就按着的，也算按了一次。对 False、True、True、False、True，配出来有两个沿——按了两次。
两个数可能不同：一次按得比采样间隔还短，可能刚好落在两次采样之间被漏掉；而板子自己的计数每次都看得到。真的按钮还会抖动——按一下在几毫秒里来回跳好几次——这个程序假定采样已经是干净的。怎么对付抖动见「嵌入式编程模式」一页。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 count_presses 与一个只走一遍样本、用变量记住上一个状态的版本逐一核对，其中有全是 True 和全是 False 的列表。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 count_presses 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: Wait here, asking every 20 ms, until B has been pressed. A press of B made before this line runs also counts, because was_pressed remembers it.
lineNotes.zh: 在这里等、每 20 毫秒问一次，直到 B 被按过。这一行运行之前按的那一下也算，因为 was_pressed 记着它。

lineNotes.en: The board's own total for button A since the reset before sampling: the number to compare with.
lineNotes.zh: 板子自己记的、从采样前清零以来 A 键的累计次数：拿来对照的那个数。

blurb.en: Read the accelerometer's x and y, call small readings flat, and otherwise pick the axis tipped the most - then show an arrow for it.
blurb.zh: 读加速度计的 x 与 y：读数小就算平放，否则挑倾得最多的那个轴——再显示一个对应的箭头。

en: What the board shows: lying flat on the table, a small square in the middle. Tip it and an arrow appears instead - left, right, up the display or down it - changing within a tenth of a second as you tilt it another way.

accelerometer.get_x() and get_y() return whole numbers in milli-g, thousandths of the pull of gravity. According to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation the default range is about -2000 to 2000; tipped right over on one side, one axis reads roughly 1000 (plus or minus) and flat on a table both read near 0. The documentation does not say which way of tipping makes each reading positive, and there is no board here to try it on, so the names right, left, back and forward are this program's choice: if an arrow points the wrong way on your board, swap the two names in tilt.

tilt answers in three steps. If both readings are smaller in size than threshold - abs ignores the sign - the board counts as flat. Otherwise the axis with the bigger size wins; when the two are equal, x wins. Finally the sign of the winning reading picks the side: positive x is right, negative is left; positive y is back, negative is forward.

The two comparisons at the threshold are deliberate. A reading exactly equal to threshold is not flat, because the test uses strict less-than; with THRESHOLD at 300, readings of 299 and 0 are flat but 300 and 0 is right. And the second test uses greater-than-or-equal, which hands ties to x, so 400 and -400 is right, not forward.

ARROWS turns the answer into a picture: a dictionary whose keys are the five words and whose values are built-in images. main reads both axes, asks tilt, shows the matching image and waits 100 ms before asking again.

The page's checker compares tilt with a version that sorts the two axes by size (x first on a tie) and only then compares the winner with the threshold on a few hundred made-up inputs, about four in ten of them with a reading exactly at the threshold. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why tilt must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子上看到的：平放在桌上时，中间一个小方块。一倾斜就换成箭头——向左、向右、朝点阵上方或下方——换个方向倾，十分之一秒内箭头跟着变。

accelerometer.get_x() 与 get_y() 交回整数，单位是 milli-g，即重力的千分之一。据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，缺省量程约 -2000 到 2000；整块侧立时某个轴约为正负 1000，平放在桌上两个轴都接近 0。文档没写往哪边倾让读数为正，这里也没有板子可试，所以 right、left、back、forward 这几个名字是本程序自己定的：你的板子上箭头若指反了，就在 tilt 里把那两个名字对调。
tilt 分三步回答。两个读数的大小都小于 threshold（abs 不管正负），就算平放。否则大小更大的那个轴赢；两个一样大时 x 赢。最后看赢的那个读数的正负：x 为正是 right，为负是 left；y 为正是 back，为负是 forward。
阈值处的两个比较是有意为之。读数恰好等于 threshold 不算平放，因为用的是严格小于；THRESHOLD 为 300 时，299 与 0 算平放，300 与 0 却是 right。第二个判断用大于等于号，平局归 x，所以 400 与 -400 是 right，不是 forward。
ARROWS 把答案变成图：一个字典，键是那五个词，值是内置图片。main 读两个轴、问 tilt、显示对应的图，等 100 毫秒再问。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 tilt 与一个先把两个轴按大小排序（平局 x 在前）、再拿赢家和阈值比的版本逐一核对，其中约四成有一个读数恰好等于阈值。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 tilt 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: Both axes are under the threshold, so the rest of the function is skipped.
lineNotes.zh: 两个轴都没到阈值，函数其余部分不再执行。

lineNotes.en: Look the word up in the dictionary to get its picture.
lineNotes.zh: 拿这个词去字典里查出它的图。

title.en: A Spirit Level on the LEDs

blurb.en: Map a sideways tilt reading from -1024..1023 onto the five columns of the display with whole-number division, holding it at the edge when the reading goes past either end.
blurb.zh: 用整除把 -1024..1023 的左右倾斜读数映射到点阵的五列上，读数越过两端时停在最边上那一列。

en: What the board shows: a vertical bar of five lit LEDs, one full column. Held level, the bar sits in the middle column; tip the board one way and it slides column by column towards that edge, and it stays on the end column however far you tip. It follows the tilt about twenty times a second.

The reading is accelerometer.get_x(), in milli-g. According to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation the default range reaches about -2000 to 2000, but tipping the board fully on its side only gives about plus or minus 1000, so the level uses -1024 to 1023 - 2048 readings - and clamps anything beyond them: a reading below LOW becomes LOW, one above HIGH becomes HIGH. Which way of tipping gives positive readings is not stated in the documentation and was not tried on a board here.

Cutting 2048 readings into 5 strips: (reading - LOW) is how far along the range the reading is, 0 to 2047. Multiplying by 5 and whole-number dividing by 2048 gives 0 to 4. Multiply first: 1500 // 2048 is 0, so dividing first would give column 0 for almost every reading. The strips are as equal as whole numbers allow; the edges are at -614, -204, 205 and 615 - a reading of 204 is still column 2, 205 is column 3.

Why not round((reading - LOW) * 5 / 2048)? Rounding makes the two end columns half as wide as the others, and at the top of the range it rounds 4.998 up to 5 - a column the display does not have, so set_pixel would fail.
main clears the display and relights column col on all five rows every 50 ms, which is what makes the bar seem to slide.

The page's checker compares column with a version that walks the four column edges one at a time using exact fractions on a few hundred made-up inputs, half of them right on a column edge or one below it, others past either end. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why column must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子上看到的：一条竖着的亮条，整整一列五个 LED。端平时亮条在正中那一列；往一边倾，它一列一列朝那边挪，倾得再多也停在最边上那一列。每秒大约跟着倾斜更新二十次。
读数是 accelerometer.get_x()，单位 milli-g。据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，缺省量程约 -2000 到 2000，但把板子完全侧立也只有正负 1000 左右，所以水平仪取 -1024 到 1023 这 2048 个读数，超出的夹住：小于 LOW 的当成 LOW，大于 HIGH 的当成 HIGH。往哪边倾读数为正，文档没写，这里也没有板子试过。
把 2048 个读数切成 5 条：(reading - LOW) 是读数在区间里走了多远，0 到 2047。乘以 5、再整除 2048，得到 0 到 4。要先乘：1500 // 2048 是 0，先除的话几乎每个读数都落在第 0 列。五条在整数允许的范围内一样宽；分界在 -614、-204、205、615——读数 204 还在第 2 列，205 就到第 3 列。
为什么不用 round((reading - LOW) * 5 / 2048)？四舍五入会让两头那两列只有别的列一半宽，而且在区间顶端把 4.998 舍入成 5——点阵没有这一列，set_pixel 会出错。
main 每 50 毫秒清一次屏、把 col 这一列的五行重新点亮，亮条看上去就在滑动。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 column 与一个用精确分数、逐个比较四条列分界的版本逐一核对，其中一半恰好落在列分界上或比它小 1，另有越过两端的读数。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 column 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.at: SPAN = HIGH - LOW + 1    # 2048 possible readings between them
lineNotes.en: The + 1 counts both ends: from -1024 to 1023 inclusive is 2048 whole numbers.
lineNotes.zh: + 1 把两端都算上：-1024 到 1023（含两端）共 2048 个整数。

lineNotes.en: Only the x axis matters for this level: tipping forwards or backwards changes y, which is ignored.
lineNotes.zh: 这个水平仪只看 x 轴：前后倾改变的是 y，这里不管它。

blurb.en: Turn a compass heading in degrees into N, NE, E and so on: add half a slice, whole-number divide, and wrap round with %.
blurb.zh: 把以度计的罗盘航向换成 N、NE、E 这些方位：先加半格、再整除、最后用 % 绕回来。

en: What the board shows: first the calibration - according to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation, calibrate() scrolls an instruction and then you tilt the board around to fill the display with lit LEDs; the program waits until you have done it. After that, the name of the nearest compass point - N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW - scrolls past every half second or so, and changes as you turn the board.

compass.heading() returns the heading as a whole number of degrees, clockwise with north as 0. The documentation describes the range as 0 to 360; point handles 360 as north as well. It was not tried on a board here.

Each of the eight points owns a 45-degree slice centred on it: N covers 338 to 22, NE 23 to 67, E 68 to 112, and so on. Adding half a slice, 22.5, before whole-number dividing by 45 makes the division round to the nearest point instead of always rounding down. Doubling everything keeps it in whole numbers: double the heading, add 45, then whole-number divide by 90. For 40 that is 125 divided by 90, index 1, NE; for 22 it is 89 divided by 90, index 0, N.

From 338 upwards the index comes out as 8, one past the end of NAMES. Taking the remainder after dividing by 8 wraps 8 back to 0, so 350 is N again - the same trick as a clock going from 12 back to 1.

Just dividing, heading // 45, would be wrong: it rounds down, so 40 would be N although it is much nearer NE. (Python's round(heading / 45) would happen to give the right answer for whole-number headings, because heading / 45 is never exactly halfway between two whole numbers - but it would need a float and depend on how round treats halves.)

The page's checker compares point with a version that adds 45/2 as an exact fraction and then divides on a few hundred made-up inputs, half of them right on either side of a slice edge. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why point must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子上看到的：先是校准——据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，calibrate() 会滚动一段说明，然后你转动、倾斜板子，把点阵上的灯全填亮；程序一直等到你做完。之后大约每半秒滚过一次最近方位的名字——N、NE、E、SE、S、SW、W 或 NW——转动板子时跟着变。
compass.heading() 交回整数度数的航向，北为 0、顺时针。文档写的范围是 0 到 360；360 在 point 里同样算北。这里没有板子试过。
八个方位各占以自己为中心的 45 度一格：N 管 338 到 22，NE 管 23 到 67，E 管 68 到 112，依此类推。在整除 45 之前先加半格 22.5，除法就是取最近的方位，而不是一律往下舍。全乘 2 就不出现小数：航向乘 2、加 45、再整除 90。40 算出来是 125 整除 90，下标 1，NE；22 算出来是 89 整除 90，下标 0，N。
338 及以上算出的下标是 8，比 NAMES 的末尾还多一个。取除以 8 的余数，把 8 绕回 0，所以 350 又是 N——就像钟面从 12 走回 1。
直接除，heading // 45，是错的：它一律往下舍，于是 40 成了 N，其实它离 NE 近得多。（Python 的 round(heading / 45) 对整数航向恰好也对，因为 heading / 45 从不恰好落在两个整数正中间——但它要用浮点数，还取决于 round 怎么处理一半的情况。）
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 point 与一个用精确分数加上 45/2 再整除的版本逐一核对，其中一半落在格子分界的两侧。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 point 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: Clockwise from north, one name every 45 degrees, so index k is the point at 45 * k degrees.
lineNotes.zh: 从北开始顺时针，每 45 度一个名字，所以下标 k 就是 45 * k 度处的方位。

lineNotes.en: scroll rather than show, so that a two-letter name like NE reads as one word.
lineNotes.zh: 用 scroll 而不是 show，两个字母的 NE 才读得成一个词。

blurb.en: Send three readings from one micro:bit to another as a line of text like 7,21,180, and split it back into three numbers - giving up on anything without exactly three fields.
blurb.zh: 把三个读数写成 7,21,180 这样一行文字，从一块 micro:bit 发给另一块，再切回三个数——字段不是恰好三个的一律放弃。

en: What the boards show: put this program on two micro:bits. Press button A on either one and it sends its device number, temperature and light level; the other board scrolls the temperature it received, in degrees Celsius. Both boards listen all the time, so either can send.

radio.on() switches the radio on and radio.config(group=12) puts the board in group 12; according to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation a group is 0 to 255 (0 by default), and boards only hear messages from the same group. radio.send sends a string. radio.receive() hands back the next message waiting, or None when there is none - which is why main checks for None before doing anything with it.

encode writes the three numbers as text separated by commas: device 7, 21 degrees and light 180 become 7,21,180. temperature() is the board's temperature in degrees Celsius and display.read_light_level() a light level from 0 to 255, both measured by the micro:bit itself.

parse undoes it: splitting cuts the text at every comma into a list of pieces. A message with exactly three pieces becomes a tuple of three ints; anything else - an empty message, or one from a program that sends two or four fields - gives None, and main quietly ignores it. The pieces must be whole numbers: a field like abc would stop the program with an error, because checking for that is a job for try and except, covered on the Files & Exceptions page.
The same readings can go as three bytes instead of text - see Radio Packet as Bytes.

The page's checker compares parse with a version that unpacks the pieces straight into three names and catches the ValueError that a wrong count raises on a few hundred made-up inputs, about three in ten of them with the wrong number of fields. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why parse must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 两块板子上看到的：把这个程序放进两块 micro:bit。在任意一块上按 A 键，它就发出自己的设备号、温度和光线强度；另一块滚动显示收到的温度（摄氏度）。两块一直都在听，所以哪块都能发。
radio.on() 打开无线电，radio.config(group=12) 把板子放进第 12 组；据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，组号是 0 到 255（缺省 0），板子只听得见同组发来的报文。radio.send 发一个字符串。radio.receive() 交回下一条等着的报文，没有时交回 None——所以 main 先判断是不是 None 再往下做。
encode 把三个数写成用逗号隔开的文字：设备 7、21 度、光线 180 变成 7,21,180。temperature() 是板子测到的摄氏温度，display.read_light_level() 是 0 到 255 的光线强度，都由 micro:bit 自己测。
parse 反过来做：在每个逗号处把文字切开，切成一个列表。恰好三段的报文变成三个 int 组成的元组；别的——空报文，或别的程序发来的两段、四段——一律交回 None，main 就悄悄不理它。每段都得是整数：像 abc 这样的字段会让程序报错停下，因为防这一手要用 try 和 except，在「文件与异常」一页讲。
同样的读数也可以不用文字、改用三个字节发——见「无线电报文：字节」。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 parse 与一个把各段直接解包给三个名字、用 ValueError 接住个数不对的版本逐一核对，其中约三成字段数不对。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 parse 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: Each piece is still text; int turns "21" into 21 and "-3" into -3.
lineNotes.zh: 每一段还是文字；int 把 "21" 变成 21，把 "-3" 变成 -3。

lineNotes.en: Only sends when A was pressed since the last time round the loop; receiving happens every time round.
lineNotes.zh: 只有自上一轮以来按过 A 才发；收报文则每一轮都做。

blurb.en: Send the same three readings as three bytes. A byte only holds 0 to 255, so a negative temperature goes out as 256 more and comes back by taking 256 off anything above 127 - an 8-bit two's complement.
blurb.zh: 同样的三个读数改用三个字节发。一个字节只装得下 0 到 255，所以负的温度发出去时加 256，收回来时凡大于 127 的减 256——这就是 8 位二进制补码。

en: What the boards show: the same as with Radio Packet as Text. Put the program on two micro:bits; press button A on one and the other scrolls the temperature it received. The two versions cannot talk to each other: this one sends and receives bytes, the other text.

radio.send_bytes sends a bytes object and radio.receive_bytes() hands back the next one waiting, or None - as described in the micro:bit MicroPython documentation. Three bytes instead of a line like 7,21,180 (8 characters) makes a shorter message, and there is nothing to split.

bytes([7, 21, 180]) makes three bytes from a list, but every item must be 0 to 255: bytes([-5]) is an error. So encode sends the remainder of temp divided by 256. In Python a negative number % 256 lands in 0..255: -5 % 256 is 251, -1 is 255, -128 is 128, while 0 to 127 stay as they are.

decode reverses it. Indexing a bytes object gives an int, so packet[1] is 0 to 255. Anything above 127 had been a negative number, so taking 256 off gets it back: 251 becomes -5, 255 becomes -1, 128 becomes -128. That is 8-bit two's complement: 0 to 127 mean themselves, 128 to 255 mean -128 to -1, and a byte can carry any temperature from -128 to 127. The device number and the light level are never negative, so they stay 0 to 255.
main only decodes a packet with exactly three bytes; anything else - from a different program in the same group - is ignored.

The page's checker compares decode with a version that reads each byte with int.from_bytes, the middle one with signed=True on a few hundred made-up inputs, often with the temperatures -1, -128, 127 and 0. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why decode must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 两块板子上看到的：和「无线电报文：文本」一样。把程序放进两块 micro:bit；在一块上按 A，另一块滚动显示收到的温度。两个版本之间互相听不懂：这个收发的是字节，那个是文字。
radio.send_bytes 发一个 bytes 对象，radio.receive_bytes() 交回下一条等着的，没有就交回 None——照 micro:bit MicroPython 文档的说法。三个字节比 7,21,180 这样一行（8 个字符）短，而且不用切分。
bytes([7, 21, 180]) 用列表造三个字节，但每一项都得在 0 到 255：bytes([-5]) 会出错。所以 encode 发的是 temp 除以 256 的余数。Python 里负数对 256 取余落在 0..255：-5 % 256 是 251，-1 是 255，-128 是 128，0 到 127 保持不变。

decode 反过来。对 bytes 取下标得到 int，所以 packet[1] 在 0 到 255。大于 127 的原来是负数，减去 256 就回来了：251 变回 -5，255 变回 -1，128 变回 -128。这就是 8 位二进制补码：0 到 127 就是它本身，128 到 255 表示 -128 到 -1，一个字节能装下 -128 到 127 的任何温度。设备号和光线强度不会是负数，所以它们照旧是 0 到 255。
main 只解码恰好三个字节的报文；别的——同组里别的程序发来的——一律不理。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 decode 与一个用 int.from_bytes 逐个读字节、中间那个带 signed=True 的版本逐一核对，其中常出现 -1、-128、127、0 这几个温度。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 decode 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: A bytes object indexes like a list of ints: packet[1] is the middle byte as a number from 0 to 255.
lineNotes.zh: bytes 对象取下标就像一个 int 列表：packet[1] 是中间那个字节，0 到 255 之间的数。

lineNotes.at: if packet is not None and len(packet) == 3:
lineNotes.en: and stops early: when packet is None, len(packet) is never evaluated.
lineNotes.zh: and 会提前停：packet 是 None 时，len(packet) 根本不会算。

blurb.en: Work out a note's frequency from its name and octave - A4 is 440 Hz and each semitone multiplies by the 12th root of 2 - then play a scale with music.pitch, and the same kind of notes by name with music.play.
blurb.zh: 从音名和八度算出频率——A4 是 440 赫兹，每升一个半音乘以 2 的 12 次根——再用 music.pitch 弹一段音阶，用 music.play 按音名弹同样的音。

en: What the board plays: press button A and it plays the C major scale from C4 up to B4, seven notes of 300 milliseconds each. Press button B and it plays C, E, G and the C above, named as note strings. On a micro:bit V2 the sound comes from the built-in speaker (and pin 0); according to the micro:bit MicroPython documentation, headphones or a speaker can also be connected to pin 0 and GND.

Every octave doubles the frequency, and an octave is 12 semitones, so each semitone multiplies by the 12th root of 2, about 1.0595. Starting from A4 at 440 Hz, a note n semitones away is 440 * 2 ** (n / 12). frequency rounds that to whole hertz because music.pitch wants a whole number: A4 is 440, C4 is 262, C5 is 523.

steps counts semitones from A4: SEMITONES gives how far the note is above C in its own octave, 12 * (octave - 4) moves whole octaves, and A itself is 9 above C, so 9 comes off. For C4 that is 0 + 0 - 9 = -9; for A4, 9 + 0 - 9 = 0. Only the seven white-key names are in the dictionary here.

music.pitch(frequency, duration) plays a whole-number frequency for that many milliseconds. music.play takes note strings in the form NOTE[octave][:duration]: C4:2 is C in octave 4 for 2 ticks, and a note without an octave or duration keeps the ones before it, so E and G are also octave 4 and 2 ticks. The default octave is 4, the one containing middle C.

The page's checker compares frequency with a version that looks up the octave-4 frequencies in a table and doubles or halves them for other octaves on a few hundred made-up inputs - every note name in octaves 0 to 8. It runs on an ordinary computer, not on a micro:bit: the hardware names are replaced by stand-ins that refuse to be called, which is why frequency must not touch the display, the buttons or sleep.
zh: 板子弹出来的：按 A 键，弹 C4 到 B4 的 C 大调音阶，七个音、每个 300 毫秒。按 B 键，弹 C、E、G 和高八度的 C，用音名字符串写。micro:bit V2 从板载扬声器（以及 0 号引脚）出声；据 micro:bit MicroPython 文档，也可以在 0 号引脚与 GND 之间接耳机或扬声器。
每高一个八度频率翻倍，一个八度是 12 个半音，所以每个半音乘以 2 的 12 次根，约 1.0595。从 440 赫兹的 A4 出发，相距 n 个半音的音是 440 * 2 ** (n / 12)。frequency 把它取整到整数赫兹，因为 music.pitch 要整数：A4 是 440，C4 是 262，C5 是 523。
steps 数的是离 A4 几个半音：SEMITONES 给出这个音在本八度里比 C 高几个半音，12 * (octave - 4) 跨整个八度，A 本身比 C 高 9，所以减 9。C4 是 0 + 0 - 9 = -9；A4 是 9 + 0 - 9 = 0。这里的字典只有七个白键的音名。
music.pitch(frequency, duration) 按整数频率弹这么多毫秒。music.play 收 NOTE[octave][:duration] 形式的音名字符串：C4:2 是第 4 八度的 C、2 拍；没写八度或时值的音沿用前面的，所以 E、G 也是第 4 八度、2 拍。缺省八度是 4，也就是中央 C 所在的那一个。
页面的检查器在几百组随手造的输入上，把 frequency 与一个查第 4 八度频率表、其他八度按倍数翻倍或减半的版本逐一核对——覆盖 0 到 8 八度里的每个音名。它跑在普通电脑上、不在 micro:bit 上：硬件名字都换成了一被调用就报错的替身——所以 frequency 不许碰点阵、按钮或 sleep。

lineNotes.en: The gaps are 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2: E to F is only one semitone, and B to the next C is the last 1.
lineNotes.zh: 间隔依次是 2、2、1、2、2、2：E 到 F 只差一个半音，B 到下一个 C 是最后那个 1。

lineNotes.en: C5:4 changes both the octave and the length for the last note.
lineNotes.zh: C5:4 为最后一个音同时改了八度和时值。
